load_wall.description: Load a message feed: the wall of an object, the user's conversation list, comments or reviews — depending on the object type. Changes nothing, supports paging and full-text search.

params.obj_type: Feed type: main_conversation — the user's conversation list, main_conversation_on_main_page — its shortened variant, conversation — the messages of a conversation, project, community, user, calendar_event and other object types — the object wall
params.obj_id: ID of the object whose feed is requested
params.last_shown_conversation_id: ID of the last item already shown — paging continues from it
params.obj_limit: Selection offset when loading in portions
params.search_string: Search string matched against message text
params.sub_obj_type: Conversation branch refinement: for example from_player or gamemaster in an application conversation

add_comment.description: Post a message: a wall comment, a conversation message, a review with a rating or a poll. Some fields apply only to tasks (status, priority, due date, assignee) and only to polls (question and answer options).

params.obj_type: Type of the object the message is addressed to: conversation, project, community, task, application, calendar_event_notion, user_notion and other site object types
params.obj_id: ID of the object the message is addressed to
params.sub_obj_type: Conversation branch refinement: for example from_player or gamemaster in an application conversation
params.name: Message title; used where a message has a subject
params.conversation_id: ID of the conversation the message goes to; 0 means resolve it from the object
params.use_group_name: on — sign the message with the group name instead of the user name
params.parent: ID of the message this one replies to; 0 means a top-level message
params.vote_name: Poll question — turns the message into a poll
params.vote_answer: Poll answer options: vote_answer[0], vote_answer[1] and so on
params.parent_obj_type: Type of the parent object if the message is created together with a new object
params.status: Status of the task being created
params.priority: Priority of the task being created
params.date_to: Due date of the task being created
params.responsible: ID of the person responsible for the task being created

vote.description: Cast a vote in a poll posted as a message. The vote of the current user is recorded and the updated results are returned.

params.m_id: ID of the message holding the poll
params.value: Number of the chosen answer option
params.type: Poll kind, set by the interface when the vote is sent
